history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-18: the owner asked for the attack preferences to be tuned by class. This is the pilot that RULES 16 requires first; verysmall, small and larger only after its gate and the owner (RULES 14).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-18, before any result on 4a482c58 was read. Pilot (RULES 16). The #151/#164 bundles on older refs are
context only.
Gate:
- no config_error; one binary; each arm's lines in its borg.txt and the resolved per-class values in
  params-core.json of the death replays;
- every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn bursts classified and key outliers listed;
- death bundles reproduced.
Read per class (each class's own starts), not pooled:
- deaths and causes, final level, deepest level;
- paired rescued and newly killed against ctl, and identical plays per class (Rangers are expected identical in
  strong: their only preference is already at the cap);
- per game, attacks by family (melee, projectile, thrown, spell, device, activation) from the messages, and
  ammunition, flasks and spell points left at death.
Two starts per class per arm show only whether a value changes play in that class. Per-class direction needs the
next tiers (verysmall 5, small 10, medium 40 starts per class), dropping the arms and classes that played ctl's
keys.
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs main 4a482c58, does each class do better with its shipped attack preferences than with neutral preferences (1000), or with their distance from neutral halved or made half again larger?
